prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported severity of the crash, and the symptom pattern fits a soft-tissue strain of the lumbar region. Over the course of 18 visits, care included manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as pain and mobility improved. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion were noted and support the diagnosis, while neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise, returned normal results. The patient reports a prior mild strain in the same region several years earlier, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service with no duplicate or repeated entries. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and activity as tolerated.
